description: Ask the reader's AI model for a plan to tidy the folder tree and return it for review; nothing changes. Use it when the reader asks to reorganise in general; for one specific change call driftnet_create_folder, driftnet_update_folder or driftnet_move_items directly. Takes no parameters: it always looks at the whole tree. The plan has at most 50 operations (create a folder, rename or merge a built-in folder, move cards), each with a reason, and never touches cards the reader filed by hand or folders they made. It sends folder names and descriptions plus card names and tags (not summaries) to the model. Each call can return a different plan, and it takes a few seconds (one time-limited model call). Show the plan to the reader; they apply it on the web page (Folders → Suggest folders), where it can be undone. Fails when no model is configured or the answer is unusable.
name: driftnet_suggest_folders
title: Propose a tidier folder tree
